title: nrf_fuel_gauge leaf callees: idiomatic C, function-level Renode M55 verified
approach: Bottom-up. No machine-level CFG lifter, no fg_cpu register VM, no fg_call trampoline. Leaf callees decompiled from typographic/stock Thumb into scalar-float C (Nordic public structs used only for the 0xE8-byte model-state size on the TTE-params leaf). Each leaf compared to its typographic body on Renode 1.17 Cortex-M55 (native FPU), then the typographic body was removed from production g2c_fuel_gauge_cores.S.

harness.platform: Renode 1.17.0+20261102gite8c7c2d28, CPU.CortexM cpuType cortex-m55, FpuEnabled, CPACR 0x00F00000, SP 0x2007FB00, RESULT 0x20068000, halt 0x30000000
harness.inputs: IEEE specials (signed zeros, denorms, inf, qNaN, sNaN, 2^23/2^24, etc.) plus xorshift random bit patterns (seed 0xC0FFEE). Two-arg leaves also ran the full specials x specials grid.

leaves.notes: f32 bits in r0 -> f64 bits in r0:r1. Matches vcvt.f64.f32, including denormal normalize and sNaN quieting (top mantissa bit).
Integer ABI on two doubles' register halves. Returns 1 iff either high word satisfies unsigned HI on CMN #0x100000, hi<<1 (qNaN richer than canonical 0x7FF80000). Not isnan/isfinite.
Hard-float: promote s0 via 43a110, apply 43a19c to that value twice, canonicalize nonzero to 1.
Min-like. b NaN keeps a; +0 vs +/-0 returns b; ARM vcmp LT is also true when a is unordered (NaN).
Max-like. b NaN keeps a; +/-0 vs +/-0: +0 keeps a, -0 takes b; unordered (a NaN) selects b.
Integer-bit floor toward -inf, signed zero preserved. |x|<1: +x and +0 -> +0, -x -> -1.0f, -0 stays -0. Inf/NaN unchanged.
Copies params[0], params[1] to model state +0x48 / +0x4c (0xE8-byte state). No other bytes change.
